body.statement: Bonhomme--Dano--Graham Proposition 1 gives the sharp unrestricted-feedback program for the \(T=2\) predetermined-covariate binary-panel model conditional on \(X_1\), for a maintained heterogeneity support and reference measure.  Their continuous-support computations in Sections 5.1--5.3 use density representations and support grids.

attestation.note: The DOI and exact proposition and section locations are supplied; the source-scoped formulation follows the orchestrator-provided correction and no verbatim source text is reproduced.
